limitations: No SDRF consulted. Paper S1 Text protocol not read (DOCX supplement).
10 deposit-design runs QHF1_07020-07029 (Experiment DISCARD_*) are NOT deposited in PRIDE; no rows.
QEHF runs: no per-run mapping to trypsin preparation/dose/time/temperature in the record; factor columns not available for those rows.
Precursor tolerance, dissociation method not stated in record: not available.
MaxQuant parameters.txt variable-modification lists are absent (version 1.5.3/1.6.2); variable mods read from evidence.txt Modifications, so unobserved variable mods cannot be excluded.
HeLa age/sex come from Cellosaurus CVCL_0030 (donor), not from the paper; HeLa variant (parental vs S3) not stated in paper.
Deposit labels BP and Met are not defined in the record; no chemical identity asserted.
Protein-mix rows are in a separate SDRF (cell-lines template requires cell line with no reserved word).
